acceptance: A feasibility report lists, per query, whether the expression implementation runs on DataFusion at SF 0.01, with the error for each failure.
The gate gains a DataFusion expression cell; all 99 queries run on it at the gate scale.
Every DataFusion cell matches SQL or carries an evidenced classification.
The DataFusion cell is enforced in CI with the repeat-run check, its whole-gate time is measured, and a maintainer signs off.
context: 2026-10-03 feasibility (develop 964bea289, SF 0.01, evidence/rev3/t27_datafusion_feasibility.md): 97/99 run on DataFusion, 76 match SQL. Fix branches, all local and waiting for preflight: (A+C) fix/datafusion-rollup-names-true-division 2603e4fb9: rollup names and true division, 76 -> 86 match, Polars and pandas unchanged; preflight's fast tier passed. (D) fix/datafusion-rank-without-window 0d05688b9: whole-frame rank when rank() has no over(); Q44 matches 5/5 runs (was 12-13 rows), no other change. (E) inside fix/tpcds-q18-q27-null-values e2d102944: Q27 no longer errors. Expected after A+C+D+E: about 88/99 (Q18 and Q27 match once A is in). OPEN: group B (unified_frame.py aggregate rewrite multiplies aggregates inside CASE: Q20 59 66 76 77 78 98), group F (Q51 cum_sum/cum_max frames + SanityCheckPlan), and the .over() rank path still ranks NULLs first on ascending order (unlike Polars). Gate plumbing (backend-to-family map, materialize_rows for pa.Table) is a soundness path and waits for #2567.
description: Owner decision D6 (2026-10-03) puts DataFusion in the parity goal. Today the cross-surface gate runs the expression family on Polars only (DATAFRAME_BACKENDS = ("expression", "pandas") in benchbox/core/equivalence/dataframe_surface.py). benchbox/platforms/dataframe/datafusion_df.py exists. First establish whether the 99 TPC-DS expression implementations run on DataFusion, then add a DataFusion cell to the gate and enforce it.
